description: Group Edition scratch org — the closest available proxy for Starter Suite. There is NO 'starter' or 'pro suite' scratch org edition (sf org create scratch accepts only developer|enterprise|group|professional|partner-*), so a genuine Starter Suite install can only be verified on a real Starter trial org. Group is the lowest-tier scratch SKU and shares the important constraints: no custom profiles, sharply reduced object/tab limits, no Experience Cloud.
